layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Auxiliary-free human video matting methods, which rely

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: solely on input frames, often struggle with complex or am-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: biguous backgrounds. To address this, we propose MatAny-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one, a robust framework tailored for target-assigned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting. Specifically, building on a memory-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paradigm, we introduce a consistent memory propagation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module via region-adaptive memory fusion, which adap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tively integrates memory from the previous frame. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ensures semantic stability in core regions while preserv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing fine-grained details along object boundaries. For ro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bust training, we present a larger, high-quality, and diverse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset for video matting. Additionally, we incorporate a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: novel training strategy that eficiently leverages large-scale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation data, boosting matting stability. With this new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network design, dataset, and training strategy, MatAnyone

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: delivers robust and accurate video matting results in diverse

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: real-world scenarios, outperforming existing methods.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Auxiliary-free human video matting (VM) is widely recog-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nized for its convenience [21, 24, 30], as it only requires

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input frames without additional annotations. However, its

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance often deteriorates in complex or ambiguous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: backgrounds, especially when similar objects, i.e., other hu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mans, appear in the background (Fig. 2(b)). We consider

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: auxiliary-free video matting to be under-defined, as their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results can be uncertain without a clear target object.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we focus on a problem that is more appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cable to real-world video applications: video matting fo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cused on pre-assigned target object(s), with the target seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation mask provided in the first frame. This enables

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model to perform stable matting via consistent object

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tracking throughout the entire video, while offering bet-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ter interactivity. The setting is well-studied in Video Ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ject Segmentation (VOS), where it is referred to as “semi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervised"[10, 17, 34]. A common strategy is to use

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a memory-based paradigm [8, 12, 34, 46], encoding past

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frames and corresponding segmentation results into mem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ory, from which a new frame retrieves relevant information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for its mask prediction. This allows a lightweight network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to achieve consistent and accurate tracking of the target ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ject. Inspired by this, we adapt the memory-based paradigm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for video matting, leveraging its stability across frames.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting poses additional challenges compared to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VOS, as it requires not only accurate semantic detection in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: core regions but also high-quality detail extraction along the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boundary (e.g., hair), as defined in Fig. 2(a). A straightfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ward approach is to fine-tune matting details using matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data, based on segmentation priors from VOS. Recent ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proaches attempt to achieve both goals, either in a coupled

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or decoupled manner. For instance, AdaM [28] and FTP-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VM [19] refine the memory-based segmentation mask for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: each frame via a decoder to produce alpha mattes, while

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MaGGIe [20] devises a separate refiner network to process

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation masks across all frames from an off-the-shelf

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VOS model. However, these methods often lead to subop-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timal results due to limitations in the available video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting data: (i) the quality of VideoMatte240K [29], the most

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: widely used human video matting dataset, is suboptimal.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Its ground-truth alpha mattes exhibit problematic semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accuracy in core areas (e.g., interior holes) and lack fine de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tails along the boundaries (e.g., blurry hair); (ii) video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting datasets are much smaller in scale compared to VOS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets; and (iii) video matting data are synthetic due to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extreme difficulty of human annotations, limiting their gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eralizability to real-world cases [30]. Consequently, fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning a strong VOS prior for video matting with existing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting data usually disrupts this prior. While bound-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ary details may show improvement compared to segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion results, the matting quality in terms of semantic stabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity in core areas and details in boundary areas remain unsat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isfactory, as shown by the results of MaGGIe in Fig. 2(b).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Producing matting-level details while maintaining se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mantic stability of a memory-based approach is challeng-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing, especially training with suboptimal video matting data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To tackle this, we focus on several key aspects:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Network - we introduce a consistent memory propagation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism in the memory space. For each current frame,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the alpha value change relative to the previous frame is esti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mated for every token. This estimation guides the adaptive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: integration of information from the previous frame. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: “large-change" regions rely more on the current frame's in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formation queried from the memory bank, while “small-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: change" regions tend to retain the memory from the previ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ous frame. This region-adaptive memory fusion inherently

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stabilizes memory propagation throughout the video, im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proving matting quality with fine details and temporal con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sistency. Specifically, it encourages the network to focus

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on boundary regions during training to capture fine details,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while “small-change" tokens in the core regions preserve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: internally complete foreground and clean background (see

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our results in Fig. 2(b)).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Data - we collect a new training dataset, named VM800,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which is twice as large, more diverse, and of higher quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in both core and boundary regions compared to the Video-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matte240K dataset [29], greatly enhancing robust train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing for video matting. In addition, we introduce a more

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: challenging test dataset, named YoutubeMatte, featuring

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more diverse foreground videos and improved detail qual-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity. These new datasets offer a solid foundation for robust

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training and reliable evaluation in video matting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Training Strategy - the lack of real video matting data re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mains a significant limitation, affecting both stability and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generalizability. We address this problem by leveraging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large-scale real segmentation data via a novel training strat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: egy. Unlike common practices [19, 20, 30] that train with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation data on a separate prediction head parallel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the matting head, we propose using segmentation data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within the same head as matting for more effective supervi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion. This is achieved by applying region-specific losses –

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for core regions, we apply a pixel-wise loss to ensure stabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity and generalization in semantics; for boundary regions,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: where segmentation data lacks alpha labels, we employ an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improved DDC loss [32], scaled to make edges resemble

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting rather than segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We propose MatAnyone, a practical human video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting framework supporting target assignment, with sta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble performance in both semantics of core regions and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-grained boundary details. Target object(s) can be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: easily assigned using off-the-shelf segmentation methods,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and reliable tracking is achieved even in long videos with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video Matting. Due to the intrinsic ambiguity in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: auxiliary-free setting [21, 24, 30, 35, 51, 56], such tasks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generally are object-specific. Among them, human video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting [21, 24, 39, 56] without auxiliary inputs is popular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: due to its wide applications. Challenging as the auxiliary-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: free setting, being in the video domain brings in additional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: difficulties in temporal coherency. MODNet [21] extends

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its portrait matting setting to video domain with a flicker-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing reduction trick (non-learning) within a local sequence.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: RVM [30] steps further to design for videos specifically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with ConvGRU [1] as its recurrent architecture. Robust

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as RVM, it is still easy to be confused by humans in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: background. With the success of promptable segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [22, 36, 52, 57], obtaining segmentation mask for a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target human object only requires minimal human efforts.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recent mask-guided image [3, 26, 49, 50] and video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting [19, 20, 25, 28] thus leverages this convenience for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a more robust performance. Adam [28] propagates the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: first-frame segmentation mask across all frames while FTP-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VM [19] propagates the first-frame trimap. Taking the prop-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: agated mask as a rough result, their decoder serves for mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting details refinement. MaGGIe [20] enjoys a stronger

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prior by taking the segmentation mask across all frames in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stead of the first one. Taking all the segmentation masks at a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time, the network is able to perform bidirectional temporal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fusion for coherency. To mitigate the poor generalizabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity of synthetic video matting data, a common practice is to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simultaneously train with real segmentation data for seman-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tics supervision [19, 28, 30].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Memory-based VOS. Semi-supervised VOS segments the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target object with a first-frame annotation across frames [8—

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 12, 16, 27, 33, 38]. The memory matching paradigm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by Space-Time Correspondence Network (STCN) [10] is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: widely followed by current VOS methods [8, 12, 41, 46],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and achieves good performance. We thus take the memory-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based paradigm as our framework since it is similar to our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: setting except that our outputs are alpha mattes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video Consistency in Low-level Vision. To enhance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: temporal consistency across adjacent frames, the recurrent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frame fusion [42, 53] and optical flow-guided propaga-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [4–6, 54] are commonly utilized in the video restora-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion networks. Recent methods also employ temporal lay-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers such as 3D convolution [2, 43] and temporal atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [2, 7, 44, 55] during training, while other training-free

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods resorts to cross-frame attention [45, 48] and flow-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: guided attention [13, 15] in the pretrained models. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work, we find that the memory-based paradigm is effective

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enough to maintain video consistency for video matting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Methodology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Overview. Achieving matting-level details while preserv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the semantic stability of a memory-based approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poses challenges, especially when training with suboptimal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting data. To tackle this, we propose our MatAny-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one, as illustrated in Fig. 3. Similar to semi-supervised

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VOS, MatAnyone only requires the segmentation mask for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the first frame as a target assignment (e.g., the yellow mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in Fig. 3(a)). The alpha matte for the assigned object is then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generated frame by frame in a sequential manner. Specif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ically, for an incoming frame t, it is first encoded into Ft

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as ×16 downsampled feature representation, which is then

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformed into key and query for consistent memory prop-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: agation (Sec. 3.1), and output the pixel memory readout Pt.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We employ the object transformer proposed by Cutie [12]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to group the pixel memory by object-level semantics for ro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bustness against noise brought by low-level pixel matching.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 3. An overview of MatAnyone. MatAnyone is a memory-based framework for video matting. Given a target segmentation map

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the first frame, our model achieves stable and high-quality matting through consistent memory propagation, with a region-adaptive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: memory fusion module to combine information from the previous and current frame. To overcome the scarcity of real video matting data,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we incorporate a new training strategy that effectively leverages matting data for fine-grained matting details and segmentation data for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic stability, with designed losses separately.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The refined memory readout

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acts as the final feature to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be sent into the decoder for alpha matte prediction. The pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dicted alpha matte

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is then encoded to memory value

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which is used to update the alpha memory bank.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Due to limitations in the quality and quantity of video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting data, training with such data makes it difficult to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieve satisfactory stability in core regions. To mitigate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this, RVM [30] proposes a parallel head for real segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion data alongside the matting head, guiding the network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to be robust in real-world cases. However, this is not suffi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cient, as the matting head itself cannot receive supervision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from real data. Inspired by the DDC loss [32] designed for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alpha-free image matting, we devise a training strategy for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: core regions, which provides direct supervision to the mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting head with segmentation data (Sec. 3.2), leading to sub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stantial improvements in semantic stability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We also propose a practical inference strategy that allow

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for flexible application: a recurrent refinement approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applied to the first frame, based on the memory-driven

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paradigm, enhancing robustness to the given mask and re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fining matting details (Sec. 3.3).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Consistent Memory Propagation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks [28] or trimaps [19] in memory and use a decoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to refine the matting details. Such approaches do not fully

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverage the stability provided by the memory paradigm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in boundary regions, leading to instability such as flicker-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing. To address this, building on the memory-based frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work [10], our MatAnyone stores the alpha matte in an al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pha memory bank to enhance stability in boundary regions.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matching approach needs to be adjusted. Specifically, in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: STCN [10], memory values for the query frame are based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing equal importance for all query tokens. However, this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: assumption does not hold for video matting. As shown in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: New Training Scheme. Most recent video matting meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods follow RVM's approach of using real segmentation data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to address the limitations of video matting data. In these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods, segmentation and matting data are fed to the main

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: core areas, where semantic information is key. We believe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the parallel head training scheme may not fully exploit the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rich segmentation prior in the data. To address this, we pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose to supervise the matting head directly with segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion data. Specifically, we predict the alpha matte for seg-

layout_dets.text: mentation inputs and optimize the matting outputs accord-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ingly, as illustrated in Fig. 3(c).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diction for the subsequent frames. The sequential predic-

layout_dets.text: 4.1. Training Datasets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address limitations in video matting datasets in both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality and quantity, we collect abundant green screen

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos, process them with Adobe After Effects, and conduct

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manual selection to remove common artifacts also found in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Matte240K, our dataset, VM800, is (1) twice as large, (2)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more diverse in terms of hairstyles, outfits, and motion, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.2. Synthetic Benchmark

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The standard benchmark, VideoMatte [29], derived from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: VideoMatte240K, includes only 5 unique foreground

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos, which is under representative. Additionally, their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foregrounds lack sufficient boundary details, limiting their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ability to discern matting precision in boundary regions. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: create a more comprehensive benchmark, we compile 32

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distinct 1920 × 1080 green-screen foreground videos from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: YouTube, and process them similarly to our training dataset.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our benchmark, YouTubeMatte, provides enhanced detail

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: representation, as reflected by higher Grad [37] values.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4.3. Real-world Benchmark and Metric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Real-world benchmarks are essential to facilitate the prac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tical use of video matting models. Although real-world

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos lack ground truth (GT) alpha mattes, we can generate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frame-wise segmentation masks as GT for core areas ben-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efiting from the high capability of existing VOS methods.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Specifically, we select a subset of 25 real-world videos [30]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (100 frames each) with high-quality core GT masks verified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manually. MAD, MSE, and dtSSD [14] are then calculated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at the core region as core region metrics, representing se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mantic stability that is critical for visual perception.
